entities.name_en: Gendarmerie Corps of the Republic of San Marino

evidence.note: Official site publishes no email addresses (phone/form contact); registrable domain assumed. Sister corps evidenced on their own .sm domains, same pattern likely

entities.notes: Military police corps. The interforce operations centre shared with the other corps uses centraleoperativainterforze@pa.sm (evidenced on poliziacivile.sm and guardiadirocca.sm).

evidence.note: amministrazione@poliziacivile.sm, antincendio@poliziacivile.sm, atsp@poliziacivile.sm on official site
amministrazione.poliziacivile@pa.sm, centraleoperativainterforze@pa.sm — pa.sm is the San Marino public-administration shared mail domain

entities.notes: Civilian police force (traffic, fire prevention, administrative police).
Military corps guarding borders, public buildings and institutional security (Nucleo Uniformato della Guardia di Rocca). Closest body to a border guard in San Marino.

entities.name_native: Segreteria di Stato per gli Affari Interni
entities.name_en: Secretariat of State for Internal Affairs

evidence.note: segreteria.interni@gov.sm on official site — Secretariats of State use the gov.sm mail domain (cf. segreteria.affariesteri@gov.sm on esteri.sm)

entities.notes: Government department responsible for internal affairs, civil protection and oversight of police corps (ministry equivalent).

entities.name_native: Segreteria di Stato per gli Affari Esteri
entities.name_en: Secretariat of State for Foreign Affairs
entities.notes: San Marino has no ministry of defence; the Foreign Affairs portfolio traditionally includes relations concerning the military corps (Corpi Militari), whose command structure sits under the Congresso di Stato. Included as the closest defence-ministry equivalent.

gaps: No intelligence service: San Marino has no standalone intelligence agency (an Agenzia di Informazione Finanziaria exists for AML, financial not natsec — excluded).
No national cybersecurity agency or national CERT identified as a standalone body.
No dedicated defence ministry: military corps (Gendarmeria, Guardia di Rocca, Milizie Uniformate) depend on the Congresso di Stato; Secretariat for Foreign Affairs listed as nearest equivalent.
Gendarmeria publishes no email address on gendarmeria.sm (phone/form only) — domain assumed.
